<function name="SetAttacker" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the attacker ( character who originated the attack ) of the damage, for example a player or an NPC.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ent" type="Entity">The entity to be set as the attacker.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
